stage: Before opening the primary matching outcomes
scope: Selected qualitative review; not exhaustive or independent student validation
selection: For each frozen 1000-profile cohort, take the three largest absolute bachelor/graduate career Top-frequency changes, and the first lexicographic model ID adding or removing each career in the direction of that change. Also inspect the largest all-education career change when absent from those three. Preserve raw outcomes. Inspect additional cases only to investigate an observed uncertainty, naming that extra scope.
evidence: Read the frozen profile and exact relevant question responses. Distinguish enjoyment from ability, obligations, population characteristics and a broad subject liking. Respect missing specialist purposes or responsibilities. Compare career types and fields, not just coverage counts.
policy: No rule, profile, answer or question-exposure tuning in this experiment. Any observed overreach is annotated separately and never silently changes the raw counts. Neither executor is ground truth.
